paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen hi:
heading: TOUPA Omna Puanin Bawl Dia Nasemte / (Eks 35.30-36.1)

paite: "En in, Judah nam a Hur tapa, Uri tapa Bezaleel amin in ka samta hi.
english: “Behold, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

paite: Pathian Kha leh pilna leh theihsiamna leh theihna leh khutsiamna lam chiteng in amah ka dimsakta hi.
english: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship,

paite: Ama'n khutsiamna in thil lim leh mel nei in agel dia, dangka-eng leh dangka leh dal in thil abawl ding hi.
english: to devise skillful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,

paite: Huai ban ah suangmantamte a-at dia, singte lim leh mel nei in khutsiamtak in abawl ding hi.
english: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of workmanship.

paite: Aseppih ding in akiang ah Dan nam a mi Ahisamak tapa, Aholiab ka peta hi. Khutsiamna nei tengteng leng pilna lungtang ka peta a, amau nang ka hon thupiak bang in thil tengteng abawl ding uhi.
english: Behold, I myself have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all who are wise-hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you:

paite: Kihoupihna puanin, theihpihna bawm, huai tung a om zahngaihna tutphah leh puanin vanzat tengteng;
english: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant, the mercy seat that is on it, all the furniture of the Tent,

paite: Dohkan leh avante leh khawnvak koihna a van tengteng toh, gimlim maitam;
english: the table and its vessels, the pure lamp stand with all its vessels, the altar of incense,

paite: halmang thillat maitam, avan tengteng toh, tuikuang leh akhe;
english: the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, the basin and its base,

paite: nasepna puante leh siampu Aaron puan siangthoute leh atapate puansilhte, siampu nasepna mun a nasem ding in;
english: the finely worked garments—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, the garments of his sons to minister in the priest’s office—

paite: huan nilh theih thau leh Mun Siangthou a ding gimlim abawl ding ua, nang ka hon thupiak tengteng bang in ahih ding uhi," achi hi.
english: the anointing oil, and the incense of sweet spices for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded you they shall do.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen hi:
heading: Sabbath Khawlni

paite: Israel suante kiang ah thu gen in, "Chihtaktak a ka Sabbath na tan ngeingei ding uh ahi. Na khang ua kei leh nou kal a chiamtehna ahih ziak in. Nou hon hihsiangthou, TOUPA ka hi, chih na theihna ding un.
english: “Speak also to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Most certainly you shall keep my Sabbaths; for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am Yahweh who sanctifies you.

paite: Huaiziak in Sabbath na tang ding ua; nou a dia siangthou ahih ziak in. Kuapeuh hiai hihbuah sihsak ngeingei ding ahi. Kuapeuh hiai ni a nasem, amite lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi.
english: You shall keep the Sabbath therefore, for it is holy to you. Everyone who profanes it shall surely be put to death; for whoever does any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

paite: Ni guk sung nna septheih ahi dia; himahleh ani sagihna Sabbath, TOUPA a dia siangthou ahi. Sabbath ni a kuapeuh in nna khatpeuh asepleh, sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
english: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to Yahweh. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day shall surely be put to death.

paite: Huaiziak in Israel suante'n Sabbath ni atang ding ua, thukhun tawntung hi ding in, akhang-akhang un Sabbath ni atang ding uhi.
english: Therefore the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to observe the Sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.

paite: Hiai tangtawn in kei leh Israel suante kikal a chiamtehna ahi. Ni guk a TOUPA'N lei leh van abawl a, ani sagih ni akhawl a, atawldam ziak in," achi hi.
english: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel forever; for in six days Yahweh made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.’”

paite: Sinai Tang tung a Pathian in Mosi houpih a, thu agen khit in theihsakna pek nih, suangpekte, Pathian khutzung a gelh, Mosi apia hi.
english: When he finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, he gave Moses the two tablets of the covenant, stone tablets, written with God’s finger.
